_provenance.status: TEMPLATE. Nothing here is frozen, so no held-out evaluation may be run against it yet.
_provenance.rule: Training fits parameters. Validation selects algorithms and thresholds. Held-out is evaluated ONCE. Any change after viewing held-out results requires a fresh held-out session and a new spec_id.

perception_error_budget_deg.note: Allocations are fractions of the total, per plan 7.4. The total itself is frozen from E-YAW/E-STEER-CAL actuator limits BEFORE any held-out perception evaluation.

actuator_limits.source: E-YAW and E-STEER-CAL; both PENDING (require physically armed trials on real hardware)

sampling.note: Every gate must declare minimum INDEPENDENT sessions, routes, and episodes per stratum, not just hours or frames (plan 7.5). Consecutive frames within one run are clustered evidence, not independent samples.

unknown_label_handling: Uncertain reviewer labels stay `unknown`. They are never forced positive or negative, and they are reported separately rather than dropped.
consequence_of_failure: The affected OS / profile / condition stays UNSUPPORTED. Live remains disabled for that stratum; an aggregate pass may never hide a failing one.
